narrative.headline: The Mammoth are the team on the rise
narrative.blurb: 39 games on this week's slate. The Avalanche are No. 1 at 2-0-0 with a +9 goal differential. The East's last playoff spot is the Senators on 2 points. The West's last spot is the Golden Knights on 2 points. The Mammoth lead the heat check at 2-0-0 and +9 goals over the last three games.
